t: This is the site associated with the Caslon Foundry, a type foundry that cast and sold metal type. It was founded by the punchcutter William Caslon the First, probably in 1720, and for most of its history it stood in Chiswell Street, Islington. It was the oldest type foundry in London and the most prestigious. Caslon's type was admired for its distinction and legibility, and it won him the patronage of leading printers in England and on the continent. His typefaces transformed English type design and established a national typographic style.
